children: Turkish conglomerate Çalik Holding has agreed to acquire Akërni Solar, the holder of a concession to develop a 100-megawatt photovoltaic park in Albania's Vlora region, Monitor reported on November 20.

The acquisition will be made through Netherlands-registered Calik Renewables BV, which specialises in electricity generation from renewable sources. The transaction has been submitted to Albania's Competition Authority for approval.

Akërni Solar is currently owned by Dutch company Arka Energy BV, which is controlled by Hong Kong-registered Midami Limited. Its registered beneficial owners include Indian nationals Hari Prasad Kanoria and Prabhat Jain, and Albanian citizen Mirsad Uruçi, according to the National Business Centre.

The Albanian government launched a tender for the solar park in 2018, which was won by a consortium led by India's India Power Corporation, with partners Midami and Mining Resources. The project was initially valued at around €70mn, but construction never began.
Arka Energy subsequently launched arbitration proceedings against Albania in 2020, which were discontinued two years later after the claimant failed to make the required payments.
In 2025, the concession agreement was amended, with the developer completing preliminary requirements, including an electricity purchase agreement and grid connection arrangements.
Çalik already operates in Albania's banking and energy sectors, including through BKT and Çalik Albania Wind.

title: Turkey's Çalik to acquire Albanian solar park concession company
